project_type: Operational LLM-serving benchmark harness. This task is NOT a code change to the repo; it is a live operational run on a rented B300 EC2 instance driven entirely via AWS SSM send-command from the sandbox. The repo (yoreland/tpot-benchmark) is the reference for proven compose files, recipes, bench 口径, and prior run summaries.
language: Bash driver scripts run locally (sandbox) that issue AWS SSM commands; Python (SGLang / huggingface_hub) runs remotely on the instance inside Docker.
build_system: No local build. All execution happens on the remote instance via `aws ssm send-command --document-name AWS-RunShellScript`. Docker (SGLang image lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.17-cu130) is the runtime on the instance.
test_framework: No unit tests for this task. Verification = SGLang server /health returns 200, DSpark head confirmed in startup logs, and sglang.bench_serving completes with 0 failed requests producing JSONL result files.
build_command: N/A (no local build). Remote: docker run / docker compose on the instance.
test_command: N/A locally. Remote verification: `curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:30080/health` and `python3 -m sglang.bench_serving ...` inside the container.
verification_instructions: 1) SSM connectivity: `aws ssm describe-instance-information --region us-west-2 --filters Key=InstanceIds,Values=i-0230a688056b553f5` shows PingStatus Online. 2) After TP8 bring-up: /health=200, startup log contains 'Draft checkpoint bundles a DSpark head', bench c=1 produces fixed 40k input. 3) After 4P4D bring-up: router /health=200, all 4 engines healthy, prefill on GPU0-3 + decode on GPU4-7 (verify via nvidia-smi that memory splits 0-3 vs 4-7). 4) Both bench sweeps produce c{1,2,4,8,16} JSONL with 0 failed requests.
snapshot_or_generated_files: null (no checked-in generated files). Result artifacts live on the instance NVMe: /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out/ (TP8) and /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out-pd/ (4P4D). Optional repo deliverable: docs/run-summaries/b300-sglang-preview-dspark-tp8-vs-4p4d-20260914-summary.md.
setup_instructions: Access ONLY via `aws ssm send-command` (AWS-RunShellScript) to instance i-0230a688056b553f5 in us-west-2, account 077090643075. NO interactive session (session-manager-plugin not installed; start-session blocked by local policy). Poll results with `aws ssm get-command-invocation --region us-west-2 --command-id <ID> --instance-id i-0230a688056b553f5`. Long tasks (167GB weight download, server start, bench) MUST be backgrounded with nohup + log file + tail polling, OR use --timeout-seconds, to avoid invocation timeouts. Config strings containing double quotes (e.g. speculative-config JSON) break send-command quoting: base64-encode a script, write it to the instance, then execute it (this trick is proven in prior runs).
environment_constraints: Instance security group has NO ingress: 52.35.86.85 is public-unreachable. ALL bench traffic must run on the instance over loopback 127.0.0.1:30080. Sandbox reaches the instance only through SSM. DO NOT DELETE the booking or stop the instance (bookingId 5bd1f130-904a-45f9-86f7-ffc1cd580682 is billing; irreversible teardown is the orchestrator's call after results are reported). B300 is scarce and one-time; download weights once, reuse the single copy across both topologies (only docker rm -f + relaunch when switching topology, never re-download).
contribution_requirements: This is a live operational run, not a PR. No code push required. Deliverable is a results report back to the orchestrator plus an optional summary markdown under docs/run-summaries/ (parallel to the two prior 2026-09-13 summaries). Preserve the exact bench 口径 (40k in / 1.5k out, c=1/2/4/8/16) for cross-topology comparability.
key_patterns: PROVEN from prior runs and repo compose files: (a) SGLang image lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.17-cu130 (v0.5.12 has flash-mla kernel crash >=16K). (b) Pin physical GPUs with docker `--gpus '"device=0,1,2,3"'` / `'"device=4,5,6,7"'` -- `--gpus all` OVERRIDES NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and caused two engines to collide on GPUs 0-3 in the prior vLLM PD run. (c) For SGLang PD: docker-compose-pd-v4flash-b300.yaml is the proven reference (nixl transfer backend works for same-node PD; mooncake does NOT; dp-attention must stay OFF or GPU mem drops to 0; router --prefill entries include the bootstrap port; SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_MOE_NUM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK=16384 >= chunked_prefill_size; SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_*_TIMEOUT=1800). (d) Preview DSpark weights use `--moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4`, NOT megamoe -- repo+Runbook warn megamoe+EP8+DSPARK+cuda-graph crashes on B300. (e) DSpark head confirm: startup log 'Draft checkpoint bundles a DSpark head'; bench 'accept len' > 1.0 means spec-decode accepting (~1.00 means it was stripped = investigate). (f) bench_serving --random-range-ratio semantics differ from vLLM: on SGLang, 1.0 typically means fixed length -- verify with c=1 first before running the full sweep; adjust per SGLang semantics if rejected and record the change.
